final: SELECT t.transcript_id, t.transcript_date, t.other_details, COUNT(DISTINCT sec.student_id) as student_count, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT c.course_name) as courses, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT s.first_name || ' ' || s.last_name) as students, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT dp.degree_summary_name) as degree_programs FROM Transcripts t LEFT JOIN Transcript_Contents tc ON t.transcript_id = tc.transcript_id LEFT JOIN Student_Enrolment_Courses sec ON tc.student_course_id = sec.student_course_id LEFT JOIN Courses c ON sec.course_id = c.course_id LEFT JOIN Student_Enrolment se ON sec.student_enrolment_id = se.student_enrolment_id LEFT JOIN Students s ON se.student_id = s.student_id LEFT JOIN Degree_Programs dp ON se.degree_program_id = dp.degree_program_id WHERE t.transcript_id = (SELECT transcript_id FROM Transcripts ORDER BY transcript_date ASC LIMIT 1) GROUP BY t.transcript_id, t.transcript_date, t.other_details
